hooks.command: if [ -d "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.markitect" ]; then MARKITECT_ENSURE_ONLY=1 sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/markitect"; fi; true
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *"markitect mark"*) printf '%s' "$input" | sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/markitect" hook pretool ;; esac
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"agent_id"'*.markitect*|*.markitect*'"agent_id"'*) printf '%s' "$input" | sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/markitect" hook pretool ;; esac
